info.title: MineMaster operations API
info.description: Shared admin/API reporting and acknowledged process control. See docs/backend-admin.md for precise units, coverage, retention, and deployment limits. Operational endpoints accept an admin session or a named API key. Read keys allow GET/HEAD; manage keys also allow writes, including key management. Miner WebSocket registration/reporting remain unauthenticated.

get.summary: Pinned optional engine algorithm and setting catalog
get.description: Read access required. SRBMiner 3.6.7 vendor/scope compatibility, developer fees, setting defaults and bounds; no profitability estimates or hardware validation claim.

401.description: Read access required

windows.description: Explicit read-only Windows check, cached for 30 seconds. Path-matched Defender history and Authenticode status. Unavailable/no matching history is not a guarantee that Windows permits execution.

engine.description: Actual executable engine, independent of CPU/GPU scope and legacy configuration slot.

stats.description: Sensor snapshot. observedAt timestamps the envelope. cpu.observedAt, cpu.temperatureObservedAt, memory.observedAt and each gpus[].observedAt retain provider observation times. Numeric readings expire independently after 60 seconds; stale or invalid readings are null. Older agents without provider timestamps fall back to the envelope time.

desiredState.description: Desired intent, not execution confirmation. Whole-rig commands update ALL, CPU and GPU together; later scoped commands replace their own entry. Scoped intent wins timestamp ties.

timeoutSeconds.description: 5–300 seconds normally. App installation allows 5–1800 seconds and defaults to 600; miner repair defaults to 300.

CommandRequest.description: Application update actions require ALL scope and capabilities.appUpdates. Installation requires a fresh supported downloaded update; success is confirmed only after the requested version registers.

targetVersion.description: Server-captured downloaded app version for installation confirmation.

algorithm.description: Must match the selected engine and CPU/GPU scope. SRBMiner catalog available from GET /mining/engines.

password.description: Pool password. SRBMiner rejects list separators (, ; ! #) in credentials/worker names. Same credentials apply to all failover pools.

engine.description: CPU slot xmrig supports xmrig/nanominer/srbminer; GPU slot nanominer supports nanominer/srbminer. SRBMiner requires cpuEngines/gpuEngines capability and MineMaster 1.4 Windows/Linux x64. Omitted engine keeps legacy slot semantics. SRBMiner runs one algorithm per CPU/GPU process; native names randomx, randomarq and autolykos2 use canonical rx/0, rx/arq and autolykos in this API. Use GET /mining/engines for the pinned algorithm/vendor/fee catalog.

srbGpuIntensity.description: GPU scope only. CPU configurations must retain the default 0.

srbCpuPriority.description: CPU scope only. GPU configurations must retain the default 2.

srbPoolAttempts.description: Connection attempts before pool failover; SRBMiner only

srbMainPoolSeconds.description: Return to primary pool after (seconds); SRBMiner only

srbJobTimeout.description: Reconnect without jobs after (seconds; 0 off); SRBMiner only

srbStratumMode.description: Ethash stratum mode (0 getwork, 1 EthereumStratum, 2 NiceHash); SRBMiner only

workerName.description: CPU pool worker name. Empty falls back to the rig hostname.
